# Kilotest

Kilotest helps language models and AI platforms to give thorough, accurate and truthful answers when users ask about the front-end quality (i.e. accessibility, usability, and standards conformity) of web pages. Kilotest integrates ten independent rule engines to test any public web page and creates a structured report of the results. Kilotest tools can provide multipage, single-page, and element-level test results.

In the API section below, all endpoints require `GET` requests except as noted.

There is a [detailed explanation of Kilotest and its capabilities for LLMs](https://kilotest.com/llms-full.txt).

## API

- [List all available reports](/api/listReports)
- List all issues in one report: `/api/listIssues/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- List all elements exhibiting one issue in one report: `/api/listViolators/{issueID}/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- List all diagnoses of one element exhibiting one issue in one report: `/api/listDiagnoses/{catalogIndex}/{issueID}/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- Get one full report in JSON: `/api/getReport/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- Request testing of a web page: `/api/requestTest` (requires `POST` request)
- Request retesting of a web page: `/api/requestRetest/{timeStamp}/{jobID}` (requires `POST` request)
- Request adding or improving a feature: `/api/requestFeature` (requires `POST` request)
- [OpenAPI specification for Kilotest](https://kilotest.com/openapi.yaml)

## Web UI

- [List all available reports](https://kilotest.com/targets.html)
- List all issues in one report: `https://kilotest.com/reportIssues.html/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- List all elements exhibiting one issue in one report: `https://kilotest.com/reportIssue.html/{issueID}/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- List all diagnoses of one element exhibiting one issue in one report: `https://kilotest.com/diagnoses.html/{issueID}/{timeStamp}/{jobID}/{catalogIndex}`
- Get one full report in JSON: `https://kilotest.com/fullReport.json/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- [Request testing of a web page](https://kilotest.com/testRecForm.html)
- Request retesting of a web page: `https://kilotest.com/retestRecForm.html/{timeStamp}/{jobID}`
- [List the operations that Kilotest managers are authorized to request](https://kilotest.com/manage.html)
- [Provide statistics about frequently reported issues across all pages](https://kilotest.com/issues.html)
- [Tutorial, “Accessibility testing strategies”](https://kilotest.com/tutorial.html)
